name: And Everybody Loses Their Minds
look: A widescreen film still with black bars. Heath Ledger as the Joker, in smeared white clown makeup and a white nurse's uniform with pink trim, raises both hands in an exasperated shrug while ranting at a blurred figure in the foreground, in a hospital room.
use: Points out a double standard. The top caption describes something that nobody minds, and the bottom describes a smaller or similar thing that makes everyone lose their minds, echoing the Joker's speech.
slots: the similar thing that makes everyone lose their minds (bottom)
examples: A game takes two hours to download and nobody complains
The microwave takes three minutes and everyone loses their minds
A movie runs three hours and nobody bats an eye
A meeting runs five minutes over and everyone loses their minds
describe: joker in a nurse outfit throwing his hands up
heath ledger joker ranting with both hands raised
clown villain dressed as a nurse in a hospital
joker saying nobody panics when things go according to plan
dark knight hospital scene with the joker shrugging
origin: Heath Ledger as the Joker, disguised as a nurse, in the hospital scene of The Dark Knight (2008), where he says everyone loses their minds.
